component.name: Tileminal
component.summary: Terminal with tabs, splits and a session that survives restarts

description.p: Tileminal is a terminal for people who work in many shells at once. Split any terminal right or down, rearrange the panes by dragging them, and keep several tabs and windows open.

ul.li: Every window, tab, split and working directory comes back after logging out, rebooting or a crash
Recently closed panes, tabs and windows can be reopened, with a preview of their layout
Tabs and panes show the terminal title or a name of your own
Single tabs can be saved to and opened from session files
The session file is written safely and earlier versions are kept

screenshot.caption: Two tabs, one of them split into three terminals
